CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) and an organization/presentation (the listed coordinate set) are explicit, and a separate origin/status metadata for the same referent is explicit; bindings are to the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content (coordinate set) bound to a named attribute (red) for a current model instance.

D.rationale: The report separately attributes an origin/status metadata to the identified content (p0/current/n0), distinguishing status from the content listing.

O.rationale: The coordinate listing explicitly describes how the content is presented/organized for the current referent.
